description:
A revolution sparked by nuclear war, natural disaster, and misrule leads to the collapse of Japanese society. The country splits into three nations vying for hegemony, and the Sangoku era begins. Aoteru Misumi, a former agricultural officer, vows to reunify Japan. He rises through the ranks with only his knowledge and eloquence. Witness the legend of the man later hailed as a genius strategist.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

Aoteru is a young man from Ehime prefecture, with a deep knowledge of the previous Japanese era and a habit of quibbling. He intends to fulfill his promise to his wife [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/388636/Saki-Higashimachi) to unite Japan.

Born in August of the 39th year of the Yamato era, hailing from the capital of Wakayama. Held the positions of Assistant Armory Officer for the Frontier General's Unit and later Right Lieutenant General. 

Raised under his mother's rigorous "gifted education," he calls her "Mama" and is fiercely devoted to her—to the point of writing her biography. He is the heir to the main branch of the Asama family, a prestigious clan instrumental in the founding of Yamato. Driven by strong ambition and a desire for validation, he aims to end the Three Kingdoms era through his own efforts and become a figure respected by the entire nation.

While skilled in martial arts, he tends to look down on others and seeks to assert his superiority. When meeting new people or in formal settings, he abandons the Kansai-inflected Yamato dialect in favor of the "Eastern language" (standard Japanese) to project an image of superior intellect.
The strategist of Yamato's Borderland General Corps. He is a master tactician who always stays one step ahead.
Saki is [Aoteru's](https://anilist.co/character/388635/Aoteru-Misumi) wife and a strong willed woman who hates dishonesty.
The Lord of Home Affairs of Yamato. He poisoned the previous emperor in order to take control of the state, and he shows no mercy to anyone who upsets him.
The emperor of Yamato, who is a puppet of the court with a cowardly and timid personality.
